scripts.generate:ts: python3 -B generator/values.py --api target/wasm/api.json --wasm target/wasm/liblvgl.wasm --verification target/wasm/api-verification.json --output target/typescript/values.ts && python3 -B generator/typescript.py --api target/wasm/api.json --wasm target/wasm/liblvgl.wasm --verification target/wasm/api-verification.json --output target/typescript/raw.ts
scripts.generate:rust: python3 -B generator/rust.py --api target/wasm/api.json --wasm target/wasm/liblvgl.wasm --verification target/wasm/api-verification.json --output target/rust-bindings/raw.rs
scripts.build:ts: bun run generate:ts && bun build bindings/typescript/src/index.ts --target browser --outdir target/typescript
scripts.build:browser: bun run generate:ts && bun build examples/browser/main.ts --target browser --outfile target/browser/main.js
scripts.build:studio-worker: bun run generate:ts && bun build studio/src/worker.ts --target browser --format iife --outfile target/studio/worker.js
scripts.build:studio-runtime: bun run build:studio-worker && bun build studio/src/controller.ts --target browser --outfile target/studio/controller.js
scripts.build:studio: bun run build:studio-runtime && bun build studio/src/main.ts --target browser --outfile target/studio/main.js
scripts.build:ts-app: bun run generate:ts && bun build toolchains/ts/app.ts --target browser --format iife --outfile target/apps/ts/app.js
scripts.build:ts-samples: bun run generate:ts && bun build toolchains/ts/samples/*.ts --target browser --format iife --root toolchains/ts/samples --outdir target/apps/ts/samples
scripts.typecheck: bun ./node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --project tsconfig.bindings.json && bun ./node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --project tsconfig.studio.json && bun ./node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --project tsconfig.studio-worker.json
